canonical_project: China Mobile Luoyang Call Center Phase II / Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Listed among Henan's 2024 second-batch key new-infrastructure projects; total building area about 35,000 sq m, mainly including an intelligent computing center, production complex, and support facilities. A 2023 provincial digital-economy plan also named China Mobile (Henan Luoyang) Data Center among projects to accelerate. Electrical capacity not disclosed.
